0.original: Composure regained, Hermes is ready to return to his duties.

26.original: Use the lightning converger to create ball lightning.

48.original: It is held that all civil organizations should conduct their affairs with total transparency, and the Convocation is no exception.

49.original: But that doesn't mean we are obligated to show our work to unknown entities such as you. Consider yourself privileged─and behave accordingly.

50.original: Though I see new creations on a daily basis, here they look at them with a different eye. It will be interesting to observe Hermes at work.

51.original: This time we <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> get to go for a walk! Isn't it exciting?

52.original: If everyone is ready, there are a few creations I need to check on. First, we shall return to the spot where we found our wayward ambystoma.

53.original: Have care when you step outside a hub, for there may be more unruly creatures about.

54.original: All vim and vigor now. Hmph. When we were discussing his nomination, he was melancholy incarnate.

55.original: Ah yes, the ianthine petalouda. One of the newest species of the ever-popular butterfly.

56.original: ...Hm? You're still bothered about your robe? Don't be. The few specimens we repurposed won't be missed.

57.original: So beautiful, petalouda! I hope they make it into the world!

58.original: This here is a new species of petalouda we recently set loose.

59.original: It has been doing very well, managing to maintain a stable existence thus far. If it can see its observation period to the end without issue, we shall release it unto the world.

60.original: Tell me─do you know the difference between living beings and arcane entities?

61.original: It is the presence of a soul. Yet the soul isn't something you can choose to have at will.

62.original: No, it manifests only in those beings whose forms adhere to the laws of creation. That can endure on their own.

63.original: Beings that do not fulfill this requirement, such as those spontaneously born of magic or natural phenomena, do not have souls.

64.original: No matter how much it might resemble flora or fauna, if it lacks a soul, then it is considered an arcane entity.

65.original: So you see, it is not for mankind to decide what is living. That domain lies beyond our manipulation, and it is hubris to assume otherwise.

66.original: But come, let us head to the nearby beacon. I've received a report that arcane entities have gathered there.

67.original: We're meant to be observing Hermes, but instead we're stuck with Meteion...

68.original: Well, I suppose she herself serves as proof of his prowess as a researcher and creator both.

69.original: A fascinating creation─much like yourself, little one. Renowned as Hermes is for his flying life-forms, 'tis a rare privilege to be able to see one of his works in progress.

70.original: Interesting! You're interesting too! Tell me, how did you find the ambystoma?

71.original: Ah, yes. Lightning pneuma, just as the report said.

72.original: Although we call this structure a beacon due to its form, it's in fact a magical device. By manipulating the balance of elements, it keeps the isle airborne and maintains the climate thereupon.

73.original: In the course of its operation, it often sees an internal shift towards a given element.

74.original: Right now that element is lightning, which draws the pneuma here to replenish their aether.

76.original: Would you care to assist me in her stead, and feed the pneuma?

77.original: By using this lightning converger, you can harness ambient lightning and focus it into a ball. A veritable feast for our dazzling friends.

78.original: Go on, give it a try.

79.original: Go on and use the lightning converger near the pneuma. It will harness ambient lightning and focus it into a ball. A veritable feast for our dazzling friends.

81.original: See how they gather to feed. How they express themselves through their actions despite their lack of words.

82.original: Speech is not the sole defining characteristic of a thinking, feeling creature. Nor is silence an indication that they do not possess these qualities.

83.original: Be it a soulless arcane entity such as the pneuma, or an ephemeral life-form such as the petalouda, all seek to perpetuate their existence. To survive.

87.original: A good question. I can answer it from a theoretical standpoint, but it ultimately falls to the Bureau of the Architect to pass judgment.

88.original: Those with exceptional vision such as Hythlodaeus may be able to ascertain her true nature...

89.original: But to me, it doesn't matter. She is herself, and that is all I need to know.

90.original: Oh... You've finished already? I-I'm sorry... I was in the way...

91.original: Not to worry, my dear. They missed nothing of note, and we still have plenty of work for them to observe.

92.original: Next, we will head east to the Mourning Dew. I need to speak with some observers there.

93.original: ...Was there a guiding theme or any method to the madness that is this random assortment of features?

94.original: Ah, this fellow has been the talk of the bureau! The combination of a carefree aspect and endless rows of fangs is strangely charming!

95.original: It's adorable, but beware its sneeze! Hermes went flying once!
